name: Pendry Park City
positioning: Contemporary ski-in / ski-out mountain resort in the center of Canyons Village, Park City, steps from the Sunrise Gondola
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in / ski-out access in Canyons Village
Summer travelers into mountain biking and gondola-accessed trails
Families wanting residences with full kitchens and a children's program

facts.text: Pendry Park City is a ski-in / ski-out resort in the center of Canyons Village, steps from the high-speed Sunrise Gondola.
The Sunrise Gondola's 10-person cabins offer sweeping mountain views and trailhead access.
The guestrooms and suites use natural, warm design elements with a contemporary, modernist feel that pays homage to the mountain landscape.
The guestrooms have views of the Utah landscape and the surrounding resort.
The suites have kitchenettes, a nook seating area and designer amenities.
The private fitness center is open 24/7 and has Peloton and TechnoGym equipment.
Après Pendry, the slopeside lobby lounge and bar, has fireside seating and live music.
KITA is a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and sushi restaurant.
In summer, mountain biking is just steps from the hotel.
Accessible rooms have a bathroom with grab bars and a roll-in shower.
Event spaces include a grand ballroom.

highlights.text: The Sunrise Gondola gives guests high-speed service from Canyons Village to Red Pine, steps from the guestrooms.
Spa Pendry is a mountainside spa that welcomes both hotel guests and locals.
Each residence has bedroom and living areas, a fully equipped kitchen and a marble bathroom.
The Pool House offers rooftop dining and drinks with panoramic mountain views.
Paintbox, the children's program, offers custom activities, events and arts and crafts tailored to each child's age and interests.

considerations.text: Suites have kitchenettes; fully equipped kitchens come with the residences.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing during peak ski season.
WhataHotel notes limited availability due to high demand.
